        "NEXT CRUSH PEPPER, LOVAGE, A LITTLE DRY FLEA-BANE, CUMIN AND SYLPHIUM",
        "STIR IT WELL AND ADD VINEGAR, REDUCED MUST AND BROTH;",
        "PUT IT BACK INTO THE POT, THE REMAINING COLOCASIA FINISH ON A GENTLE FIRE."
      ],
